title: Danny Leung shares a new single called "Gone Too Far"
htmlContent:
London-based singer-songwriter Danny Leung shares a new single called "Gone Too Far". Follow-up of his recently released singles "Why Don't Say Hi", and "Tomorrow". The track “Gone Too Far” is an indie R&B song co-produced by Cameron Kuwada and Danny Leung himself.

Danny Leung works like a master to deliver something amazing for his fans, and doesn’t miss a single beat on this must hear record. Everything about this song is enjoyable starting with the production that has unlimited grooves to enjoy. "Gone Too Far" is that great music that makes life that much more enjoyable.
